judgments.rationale: The unchanged summary for C0000 accurately and completely captures the statutory reporting obligation set forth in subsection (b), including the full scope of subject manufacturers, distributors, and retailers, the jurisdictional scope and motor vehicle equipment exclusion, the triggering condition of obtaining information reasonably supporting any of the four disjunctive findings in paragraphs (1) through (4), the immediate timing requirement to inform the Commission, and the express exception where actual knowledge exists that the Commission has already been adequately informed. The external statutory cross-references are unavailable in the source text and properly left unresolved. Therefore, the reading is independently complete and no change is necessary.
